name: Apple
description: A common fruit found on trees all around Hyrule. Eat it fresh, or cook it to increase its effect.

name: Palm Fruit
description: The fruit of a tropical tree that grows near the ocean. It restores hearts when eaten, and its sweetness intensifies when cooked.

name: Wildberry
description: A fruit that grows in colder climates, this berry is a popular ingredient in desserts.

name: Hearty Durian
description: This fruit's odor is a bit much for some, but it has a large number of devoted fans. Cook it to unlock its life-giving potential.

name: Hydromelon
description: A refreshing fruit grown mainly in the Gerudo region. Cooking it into a dish will provide a heat-resistance effect.

name: Spicy Pepper
description: The fruit of a plant that thrives in cold climates. Cook with it to receive a cold-resistance effect.

name: Voltfruit
description: A cactus fruit that grows in the Gerudo Desert. Cooking it into a dish grants a shock-resistance effect.

name: Fleet-Lotus Seeds
description: The seeds of a plant that grows near water. Cooking them into a dish will increase your movement speed.

name: Mighty Bananas
description: A fruit that grows in tropical climates. Cooking them into a dish will raise your attack power.

name: Hylian Shroom
description: A common mushroom found near trees around Hyrule. Eat it to restore half a heart.

name: Endura Shroom
description: A rare mushroom that temporarily extends your stamina wheel when cooked into a dish.

name: Stamella Shroom
description: A green mushroom that grows near trees in the forest. Cook it to create dishes that restore stamina.

name: Hearty Truffle
description: A rare mushroom that smells absolutely delicious. Cook it to unlock its life-giving potential.

name: Big Hearty Truffle
description: A very rare mushroom prized for its rich aroma. Dishes cooked with it will temporarily increase your maximum hearts.

name: Chillshroom
description: A mushroom that grows in frigid climates. Cook it into a dish for a heat-resistance effect.

name: Sunshroom
description: A mushroom that thrives in hot regions. Cook it into a dish for a cold-resistance effect.

name: Zapshroom
description: A mushroom that grows in dry climates. Cook it into a dish for a shock-resistance effect.

name: Rushroom
description: A mushroom that grows on cliff faces. Cooking it into a dish will increase your movement speed.

name: Razorshroom
description: A mushroom with a cap as sharp as a blade. Cooking it into a dish will raise your attack power.

name: Ironshroom
description: A firm mushroom with an iron-like texture. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your defense.

name: Silent Shroom
description: A pale mushroom that glows softly at night. Cooking it into a dish will make your movements quieter.

name: Hearty Radish
description: A rare radish packed with nutrients. Dishes cooked with it will temporarily increase your maximum hearts.

name: Big Hearty Radish
description: An extra-large radish overflowing with vitality. Cooking it greatly increases your maximum hearts.

name: Swift Carrot
description: A crisp carrot grown in Kakariko Village. Cooking it into a dish will increase your movement speed.

name: Endura Carrot
description: A rare carrot brimming with energy. Cooking it into a dish will temporarily extend your stamina wheel.

name: Fortified Pumpkin
description: A hardy pumpkin grown in Kakariko Village. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your defense.

name: Raw Meat
description: Meat from animals living in the mountains. It can be cooked into a variety of hearty dishes.

name: Raw Prime Meat
description: High-quality meat from animals in the wild. Cook it for an even more delicious dish.

name: Raw Gourmet Meat
description: Meat of the highest quality, from the rarest of beasts. Cooking it brings out its full flavor.

name: Raw Bird Drumstick
description: Meat from wild birds that roost across Hyrule. Cook it for a juicy and nourishing dish.

name: Raw Bird Thigh
description: High-quality poultry from wild birds. Cook it for a tender, flavorful meal.

name: Raw Whole Bird
description: Top-quality poultry from the rarest of birds. Cooking it whole makes for an extravagant feast.

name: Ironshell Crab
description: A crab with a shell as hard as iron. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your defense.

name: Razorclaw Crab
description: A crab with claws sharp as razors. Cooking it into a dish will raise your attack power.

name: Bright-Eyed Crab
description: A lively crab found near rivers and cliffs. Cooking it into a dish will restore stamina.

name: Hyrule Bass
description: A common fish found all over Hyrule. It can be cooked into a variety of dishes.

name: Hearty Bass
description: A rare bass brimming with energy. Dishes cooked with it will restore extra hearts.

name: Staminoka Bass
description: A fish with well-developed muscles. Cooking it creates dishes that restore stamina.

name: Hearty Salmon
description: A premium fish that lives in cold waters. Cooking it will temporarily increase your maximum hearts.

name: Chillfin Trout
description: A trout that lives in frigid waters. Cooking it into a dish grants a heat-resistance effect.

name: Sizzlefin Trout
description: A trout that lives near volcanic waters. Cooking it into a dish grants a cold-resistance effect.

name: Voltfin Trout
description: A trout with fins that carry an electric charge. Cooking it grants a shock-resistance effect.

name: Stealthfin Trout
description: A mysterious trout that glows faintly at night. Cooking it will make your movements quieter.

name: Armored Carp
description: A carp covered in sturdy scales. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your defense.

name: Mighty Carp
description: A strong carp that swims against rushing currents. Cooking it will raise your attack power.

name: Sanke Carp
description: A beautiful ornamental carp found in the ponds of Kakariko Village. It's a rather high-class ingredient.

name: Armored Porgy
description: An ocean fish covered in hard scales. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your defense.

name: Mighty Porgy
description: An ocean fish with powerful muscles. Cooking it into a dish will raise your attack power.

name: Hearty Blueshell Snail
description: A rare snail that lives near the ocean. Dishes cooked with it will restore extra hearts.

name: Sneaky River Snail
description: A snail that lives in rivers. Cooking it into a dish will make your movements quieter.

name: Acorn
description: A nut often buried by forest critters. Cook it to add a nutty flavor to any dish.

name: Chickaloo Tree Nut
description: A nut from a tree commonly found in forests. It has a rich flavor when cooked.

name: Bird Egg
description: An egg from a wild bird's nest. It's an essential ingredient in many cooked dishes.

name: Courser Bee Honey
description: Honey from a courser bee hive. It's sweet, nutritious, and restores stamina when cooked.

name: Hylian Rice
description: Rice grown in the wetlands of Hyrule. It's a staple ingredient in many meals.

name: Tabantha Wheat
description: Wheat grown in the Tabantha region. Grind it into flour for breads and pastries.

name: Cane Sugar
description: Sugar made from sweet cane. It's an essential ingredient for desserts.

name: Goat Butter
description: Butter made from the milk of Hateno goats. It's used in a variety of dishes and desserts.

name: Goron Spice
description: A blend of spices brought from Goron City. It adds a rich flavor and aroma to any dish.

name: Rock Salt
description: Crystallized salt from the ancient sea. It can be ground up and used to season dishes.

name: Fresh Milk
description: Fresh milk from Hateno cows. It's used in soups, stews, and desserts.

name: Monster Extract
description: A mysterious extract made from monster parts. It's used in some very peculiar recipes.

name: Hyrule Herb
description: A common herb that grows all across Hyrule. It's used in a variety of cooked dishes.

name: Silent Princess
description: A rare flower said to have once grown near Hyrule Castle. Cooking it will make your movements quieter.

name: Armoranth
description: A flowering plant with sturdy petals. Cooking it into a dish will fortify your defense.

name: Blue Nightshade
description: A plant that glows faintly at night. Cooking it into a dish will make your movements quieter.

name: Cool Safflina
description: A herb that grows in the desert at night. Cooking it into a dish grants a heat-resistance effect.

name: Warm Safflina
description: A herb that grows in warm, dry regions. Cooking it into a dish grants a cold-resistance effect.

name: Electric Safflina
description: A herb that grows in dry climates. Cooking it into a dish grants a shock-resistance effect.

name: Mighty Thistle
description: A prickly plant that grows near cliffs. Cooking it into a dish will raise your attack power.

name: Swift Violet
description: A flower that grows on cliff faces. Cooking it into a dish will increase your movement speed.
